concept: Testing an idea to see if it's really true, instead of just guessing
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character has a guess about how something works and decides to test it rather than just assume they're right
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did testing the guess help the character find out the truth?
exercise.practice: Student makes a simple guess about something and describes how they could test it

assessment.success_marker: student proposes a real, describable way to test their guess
